Claim amendment · #31790 · 2026-11-09T07:32Z · amends the claim 6733196643 on its Clause-② line and its file surface, per the seat's ruling and the epic review 6734421619 on PR #31850. ⛔ Not a new claim; every other line stands.

Clause-②: yes (widening); narrowing per ADR-0150 D3 declared below
Metadata-protocol: none

- Widening: a declared assignment rule or a packaged flow's own approval step in package P, naming a queue two packages declare, is now served when one holder is P's own or the only one in P's declared dependencies (P depends on D, D and unrelated U hold it: D's; P holds it, U too: P's own). Before: refused `ambiguous-in-environment`. First-party: 0.
- Narrowing: such a rule or step whose queue name P cannot reach is now refused `outside-closure`, naming every candidate: the only holder is outside P's dependencies; P's dependency D is disabled and unrelated U holds it; the only holder is an environment-authored item. Before: served environment-wide. First-party: 0.
- First-party count 0 for both: no first-party package declares a queue, an assignment rule or a `queue` approver.

File surface, widened by the epic review's R1: `packages/services/service-automation/src/{engine,flow-precedence,plugin}.ts` and a new `flow-armed-package.integration.test.ts`, for the reader `AutomationEngine.armedFlowPackage` (the package of the flow body that runs, so an environment-authored override's step reads with no package).
